messages:
Noah (ENG Manager): heads up — planning to move Priya RWI-2019 from Senior IC to Eng Manager, effective 2026-06-01. Need checklist for comp update, payroll treatment, and benefits enrollment windows. who should I loop in?
Lina (People Ops): congrats to Priya! :tada: Quick owners: people-ops owns comp-change intake and benefits enrollments; hiring-ops handles HRIS title + headcount; payroll runs proration/backpay. If there's equity/bonus questions loop in comp+grants and finance.
Noah (ENG Manager): OK thx. Priya has a performance bonus that was pro-rated earlier this year — does manager bump affect bonus eligibility?
Lina (People Ops): bonus eligibility cutoff was 2026-03-31 for the cycle. A 6/1 effective date won't retroactively change that cycle. Future cycles will consider manager level. For any one-off adjustments, submit a comp exception & copy finance.
Ravi (Payroll): payroll notes: payroll cycles are 1st & 15th. For a 6/1 effective, approvals + HRIS change need to be completed by 2026-05-20 17:00 PT to reflect in the 6/1 pay. Otherwise we'll process retro pay in the following cycle.
Noah (ENG Manager): what's the proration method? full days or business days?
Ravi (Payroll): calendar days. Example: if effective 6/1 and change is in before cutoff, the 6/1-15 period will include the new base for those 15 days. If late, new base applies from the next cycle and retro covers missed amount.
Noah (ENG Manager): Thanks. Ellen — do we need to open a new headcount ticket?
Ellen (Hiring Ops): Not if headcount unchanged. I'll update title and manager field in HRIS and Org chart. I'll create HRIS ticket HRIS-5102 and link it here. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Priya (IC): quick Q — will my existing dependent elections carry over? Any action needed to get manager benefits?
Lina (People Ops): dependents remain unless you change plans. Manager-level perks (manager stipend, leadership coaching allowance) are eligible within a 30-day special enrollment window from the effective date. So you have until 2026-07-01 to opt into manager perks. We'll send automated enrollment prompts.
Ops Bot: reminder: submit comp-change form -> https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/comp-change. Approval flow: manager -> dir -> finance -> people-ops.
Noah (ENG Manager): where do I indicate equity refresh adjustments? Priya has a refresh due 2026-08-01.
Lina (People Ops): equity refresh schedule remains unless a level-triggered amendment is requested. Use the comp-change form to request grant adjustments; grants team needs ~2 weeks after approvals to issue amendments.
Noah (ENG Manager): perfect. I'll submit the comp-change form today.
Lina (People Ops): checklist for Noah: 1) submit comp-change (select "role conversion"), 2) attach manager job spec and justification, 3) confirm effective_date = 2026-06-01, 4) ping here when submitted.
Noah (ENG Manager): done — form submitted and attached spec.
Lina (People Ops): received and routed. Adding Priya and payroll to the approvals thread.
Ravi (Payroll): I see the HRIS ticket and comp-change. Waiting for approvals to queue pay. Reminder: timezone = PT for cutoff.
Priya (IC): thank you! one more question — do I get an updated title in Slack and org charts immediately after HRIS update?
Ellen (Hiring Ops): yes, after HRIS is patched most internal systems sync within 24 hours (Slack display sometimes takes a bit longer). I'll post when sync completes.
Lina (People Ops): final note: if you want a backdated base for leadership comp reasons, we need an approved comp exception before payroll cutoff — otherwise standard retro applies.
Noah (ENG Manager): understood. closing once payroll confirms.
Ravi (Payroll): will post confirmation here when retro/first pay run is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
